run_densepose_training: run the DensePose training script with a config file and GPU count via command line
run_densepose_evaluation: run the DensePose evaluation only mode using a pre-trained model weights file
build_densepose_model: build a DensePose model from config using Trainer.build_model for evaluation or training
resume_densepose_training: resume a DensePose training run from a checkpoint using DensePoseCheckpointer
setup_densepose_config: setup a DensePose config by merging a config file and command line options
